tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a catalog product to the cart. Medium risk; no human approval.

qty.description: Positive integer quantity. Do not compute totals.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Checkout the current cart. High risk: the page asks a human to approve. Simulated order — no real charge.

inputSchema.description: Checkout the current cart. No extra arguments.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two or three products by id. Pass unique ids.

ids.description: Two or three product ids to compare.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one catalog product by id (for example atlas-15).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the laptop catalog by phrase and optional maxPrice in USD. Returns id, name, numeric price, and blurb.

query.description: Natural-language product search. Pass the raw user phrase.

maxPrice.description: Optional maximum price in USD. Do not convert currency.
